regions.merged_text: God Bless us all - Yourself and myself and all our friends and honest enemies if such there be. More than six weeks ago, having readyour letter I started to respond at once . . . God help us! I just got started and here we have Sexigesima. Thanks be to God! though we've had quite a little grippe-weather the last three months, we so far, have had but one case of that epidemic. Up in Detroit since Wednesday, I just returned . . finding 3 full sets of the Mystical City of God in our Cell (% Wallace Bedolfe who was here over night about a week ago) Miss Doris Panyard of 1705 Peck Street Muskegan, Michigan just phoned me that he requested four sets -- one for himself. Deo gratias! -- a promising 23 yr. oldster who was baptised as was his elder Br. Bob and Sister Barbara. No doubt Grace has told you about them
